title: Johan Hennert
text:
Hi! I’m a PhD student in cognitive science at the University of Potsdam under the supervision of Shravan Vasishth and Ralf Engbert.
As part of Project B03 of the Collaborative Research Centre 1287, I work on modeling eye-movement control during reading of complex sentences, using Bayesian statistics to fit and compare models.
